purpose: py_internal's ctx helpers on rules_python 1.7.0's py_binary path (builtins_bzl/common/python/py_internal.bzl, rules/python/PyBuiltins.java): `_is_tool_configuration(ctx)` = `ctx.configuration.is_tool_configuration()` (BuildConfigurationValue.isToolConfiguration = isExecConfiguration, analysis/config/BuildConfigurationValue.java:750-758; a duck-typed `def`), `_get_legacy_external_runfiles(*args, **kwargs)` = False, `is_bzlmod_enabled(ctx)` = True (PyBuiltins.java:66-74, a StarlarkRuleContext parameter), `_make_runfiles_respect_legacy_external_runfiles(_ctx, runfiles)` = runfiles; with the `def` and BuiltinFunction binding errors. py_internal is available in the main repository's tools/build_defs/python (BazelRuleClassProvider). Motivation: `build --nobuild //src/beyondwork.ai/tools/...` on ~/code stopped at `analysis of @@rules_pkg+//pkg/private/tar:build_tar: ... error: py_internal.is_tool_configuration is not implemented in the native profile (analysis-time Python API)` (rules_python python/private/py_executable.bzl:1628 `_is_tool_config`, then :809 get_legacy_external_runfiles and :837 is_bzlmod_enabled in `_create_zip_file`, :1685 make_runfiles_respect_legacy_external_runfiles).

reference.environment: env -i PATH=/usr/bin:/bin HOME/TMPDIR private LANG=C.UTF-8 LC_ALL=C.UTF-8; one fresh copy of the fixture workspace per case (the genuine platforms 1.0.0 module extracted into `platforms` from tests/fixtures/label_repo_name/platforms_archive.json)

normalization: <WS> = the case's workspace copy; <OB> = the genuine output base; <CACHE> = the native cache; elapsed times <T>. Outputs are the top-level outputs (genuine --show_result lines, bazel-bin = bazel-out/k8-fastbuild/bin; native LABEL<TAB>PATH lines below the action output root) as [mode, contents].
comparison (tests/py_internal_ctx.rs, li: MATCH: success equal; WARNING lines equal in order; a failing case's genuine message (the `Error in <callable>: ` / `Error: ` Starlark text, else the rule error following an empty `in KIND rule L: ` line, else the first ERROR message) is contained in native stderr; built top-level outputs (path below bazel-out -> [mode, contents]) equal. DECLARED_DIVERGENCE: native fails with the recorded message.
genuine_key_findings: is_tool_configuration: False for a target in the target configuration (positional or named ctx, type bool), True for an exec dependency (`cfg = "exec"`) and for every dependency of an exec-configured target (its deps and exec deps); any value with `.configuration.is_tool_configuration()` works (a struct returns its callable's result, "duck").

get_legacy_external_runfiles returns False for any arguments (none, ctx, `1, 2, x = 3`); is_bzlmod_enabled returns True (positional or named ctx); make_runfiles_respect_legacy_external_runfiles returns its second argument unchanged (the same runfiles object, or any value by name).

Errors of the `def` wrappers are StarlarkFunction's (`Error: _is_tool_configuration() missing 1 required positional argument: ctx`, `accepts no more than 1 positional argument but got 2`, `got unexpected keyword argument: ctxx (did you mean 'ctx'?)`, `got multiple values for parameter 'ctx'`; `'NoneType' value has no field or method 'configuration'`, `'int' value has no field or method 'is_tool_configuration'`; `_make_runfiles_respect_legacy_external_runfiles() missing 1 required positional argument: runfiles` / `accepts no more than 2 positional arguments but got 3`); is_bzlmod_enabled's are BuiltinFunction's (`Error in is_bzlmod_enabled: in call to is_bzlmod_enabled(), parameter 'ctx' got value of type 'NoneType', want 'ctx'` (also Label), `accepts no more than 1 positional argument but got 2`, `got unexpected keyword argument 'ctxx' (did you mean 'ctx'?)`, `got multiple values for argument 'ctx'`).
is_bzlmod_enabled() without an argument crashes Bazel 9.3 (FATAL, exit 37, IllegalArgumentException: argument type mismatch; the `unbound` default reaches PyBuiltins.isBzlmodEnabled).
known_divergences: Native prints its own result format (`LABEL\tPATH`, `bazel-rs: N actions executed ...`), no INFO lines, and Starlark errors in its own traceback format without the @_builtins wrapper frame (the messages are Bazel's).
Declared divergence bad_bzlmod_missing: see the case.
Native is passed --experimental-builtin-modules in every case (as in the other paired fixtures).
